import openpyxl

path = "基础数据分析 (2)_double_counting_8708_input.xlsx"
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(path)
ws = wb["基础数据分析"]

# Fix double-counting SUM formulas (cell within range counted twice)
fixes = {
    "F18": "=SUM(F16:F17)",
    "F21": "=SUM(F20:F20)",
    "H21": "=SUM(H20:H20)",
    "F24": "=SUM(F23:F23)",
    "I28": "=SUM(I25:I27)",
}

for coord, formula in fixes.items():
    old = ws[coord].value
    ws[coord] = formula
    print(f"{coord}: {old!r} -> {formula!r}")

wb.save(path)
print("Saved.")
EOF
